name: wemember
description: Your company's memory in Claude Code: relevant Wemember context at the first prompt of a session, and optional proposals to remember what a session settled.

propose_memories.title: Propose memories at the end of longer sessions
propose_memories.description: Off by default. When on, after a session with at least 15 tool calls Claude is asked once to propose up to three decisions, preferences or agreements you stated to Wemember, as personal proposals for review.
